18155.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 3.7 miles west-northwest of Vevay had caught 37.03 inches. August was the wettest month at 7.01 inches. The biggest one-day reading was 3.02 inches on Apr 28. The longest dry stretch ran 14 days, Aug 22 to Sep 4, with nothing in the gauge, not even a trace.

18161.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station in Liberty had its wettest month in August at 14.67 inches, and the biggest single day came Aug 12 with 4.79 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 13 days, Apr 6 to Apr 18, with not even a trace in the gauge. On the days both years reported, that is 13.63 inches more than 2025.

18165.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station 4 miles west-northwest of Perrysville had its wettest month in August at 10.47 inches, and the biggest single day came Aug 14 with 2.98 inches. Lately the gauge has had nothing in it for 11 days in a row, Oct 3 to Oct 13, and that stretch is still going. On the days both years reported, this year is 14.62 inches more than last year.

18167.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 5.0 miles southwest of West Terre Haute had caught 41.55 inches. March was the wettest month at 8.13 inches, and the biggest single reading was 2.30 inches on Apr 28. The gauge went 20 days in a row with nothing in it, not even a trace, from Jan 26 to Feb 14. On the days both years reported, this year is 5.29 inches more than 2025.

18179.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge less than a mile southeast of Bluffton had 44.46 inches, 12.07 more than a usual year. August was the wettest month at 9.72 inches, and the biggest one-day reading was 4.10 inches on Sep 17. On the days both years reported, that is 19.26 inches more than 2025 had by this date.
